title: Codify 11-State Modular Task Matrix
details: Formalized pending/in-progress initial, review, audit, and refactor states along with completed, blocked, and deprecated terminal states using colon delimiter.

title: Integrate Unblock Recovery, Sub-Task Hierarchy, and Metadata Properties
details: Added reason and owner properties, dot-notation sub-task branching (TODO-01.1), unblock recovery paths, and trivial fast-track rules.

title: Integrate Mandatory Priority, Relates-To Relational Linking, and Terminal Child Completion Rules
details: Codified mandatory priority property, relates_to historical linking key, parent completion on child terminal state, section heading resilience, and numeric ID parsing.

title: Integrate Sub-Task Letter Parts (TODO-01.1a), Strict Local Relational Scope, and Priority Escalation
details: Codified sub-task letter parts (TODO-01.1a through TODO-01.1z) with strict single-level cap, enforced strict local-only relates_to scope, updated reason to Conditional, and codified priority escalation.

title: Integrate Single-Letter Sub-Task Hard Limit, Acyclic Relational Links, Primary Key Uniqueness, and Task Quality Constraints
details: Hard-limited sub-task letters to single a-z range forcing new top-level tasks beyond z, prohibited circular relates_to references, enforced primary key uniqueness, and set title/details quality length thresholds.

title: Integrate Child_Of Ancestry Key and Decoupled Relates_To Horizontal Association
details: Codified child_of property for immutable vertical ancestry guaranteeing acyclic lineage, alongside relates_to for loose horizontal association.

title: Integrate Parent-Child Blocker Propagation, Referential Integrity, Priority Regex, and Pair Owner Syntax
details: Codified parent blocker propagation when child tasks lock, enforced strict referential existence validation for child_of/relates_to, added priority regex validation, and standardized slash-delimited multi-owner syntax.

title: Integrate Sub-Task Numerical Formatting, Parent Deprecation Cascade, Empty Array Validity, and String Normalization
details: Codified unpadded integer sub-task numerical formatting (.1a), parent deprecation cascade to all active child tasks, empty todo array validity, and pre-validation string trimming rules.

title: Integrate Parent Priority Dynamic Sync, 2-Space JSON Encoding Standard, 4-Digit ID Scaling, and Cascaded Deprecation Immutability
details: Codified parent priority dynamic sync to highest sub-task priority, enforced 2-space indented UTF-8 JSON frontmatter, expanded ID regex to 4 digits (TODO-9999), and locked cascaded deprecation immutability.

title: Integrate Optional Link Anchor Key for Pragmatic Navigation
details: Codified optional link key allowing clean URI relative paths and section fragment anchors to navigate programmatically to target headings.

title: Integrate Mandatory Section Anchor Key and Deprecate Presentation Text Keys
details: Codified section key as mandatory anchor reference while deprecating raw presentation text keys in favor of clean URI strings.

title: Integrate Conditionally Mandatory *-Since Version Origin Keys and Task Protection Governance Key
details: Codified conditionally mandatory existed_since, blocked_since, and deprecated_since version tracking keys alongside protection governance status for completed tasks.

title: Integrate Companion Dataset Storage Pattern and Metadata File Pointers
details: Codified Mode 2 Companion Dataset Storage Pattern (todo_file and changelog_file metadata pointers) alongside Mode 1 embedded inline frontmatter.

title: Standardize Companion Dataset Filename and Non-Redundant Major Version Naming
details: Standardized companion dataset filename to backlog.json inside version directories, eliminating version number redundancy from internal filenames.

title: Codify Target Metadata Keys (target_version, target_file, target_component, target_repository)
details: Codified optional target metadata keys (target_version, target_file, target_component, target_repository) to eliminate reference ambiguity in cross-version and project-wide task tracking datasets.

title: Execute Orange Team Legacy Modernization & Backlog Schema Alignment
details: Renamed repository to Backlog-Schema, standardized all documentation on backlog.json, scaffolded .dev/ hub, .agents/ workspace, in-repo docs/ wiki, and completed .github/ governance suite.
